changes.from:

changes.to:
summary["post_stdout_budget_file"] = "post-stdout-budget.json"
        summary["literal_AST_reads_of_original_family_declaration_only"] = True
        summary_path = args.out / "summary.json"
        for scope, operation in (
                ("write-summary", lambda: save_json(summary_path, summary)),
                ("print-summary", lambda: print(
                    "HIA_CORE53_READBACK " + json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True), flush=True))):
            try:
                operation()
            except BaseException as exc:
                status = "FAIL"
                after_errors.append({"scope": scope, "error_class": type(exc).__name__,
                                     "error": str(exc)})
        post_self = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
        post_children = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
        post_cpu = (post_self.ru_utime + post_self.ru_stime
                    + post_children.ru_utime + post_children.ru_stime)
        post_elapsed = time.monotonic_ns() - start
        post_status = ("PASS" if status == "PASS" and post_cpu < 90
                       and post_elapsed < 180_000_000_000 else "FAIL")
        post = {"schema": "hia-core53-readback-post-stdout-budget-v1",
                "status": post_status, "aggregate_CPU_seconds": post_cpu,
                "elapsed_ns": str(post_elapsed),
                "includes_summary_write_stdout_flush_and_all_original_reads": True,
                "limits": {"CPU_seconds": 90, "wall_ns": 180_000_000_000},
                "primary_error_preserved": primary, "after_errors": after_errors,
                "project_imports": 0, "native_entries": 0, "B3_entries": 0}
        if post_status != "PASS":
            status = "FAIL"
        post_path = args.out / "post-stdout-budget.json"
        try:
            post_raw = (json.dumps(post, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
            with post_path.open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(post_raw)
            require(post_path.read_bytes() == post_raw, "post-output receipt full readback")
        except BaseException as exc:
            status = "FAIL"
            after_errors.append({"scope": "post-output-receipt-write-readback",
                                 "error_class": type(exc).__name__, "error": str(exc)})
        final_self = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
        final_children = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
        final_cpu = (final_self.ru_utime + final_self.ru_stime
                     + final_children.ru_utime + final_children.ru_stime)
        final_elapsed = time.monotonic_ns() - start
        if final_cpu >= 90 or final_elapsed >= 180_000_000_000:
            status = "FAIL"
            after_errors.append({"scope": "strict-final-post-receipt-budget",
                                 "aggregate_CPU_seconds": final_cpu,
                                 "elapsed_ns": str(final_elapsed)})
        if status != "PASS":
            summary.update(status="FAIL", primary_error=primary, after_errors=after_errors,
                           final_aggregate_CPU_seconds=final_cpu,
                           final_elapsed_ns=str(final_elapsed),
                           final_measurement_includes_post_receipt_readback=True)
            # Failure of either output cannot replace the original reader failure.
            for scope, operation in (
                    ("rewrite-final-FAIL-summary", lambda: save_json(summary_path, summary)),
                    ("print-final-FAIL-summary", lambda: print(
                        "HIA_CORE53_READBACK_FINAL_FAIL " + json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True),
                        flush=True))):
                try:
                    operation()
                except BaseException as exc:
                    after_errors.append({"scope": scope, "error_class": type(exc).__name__,
                                         "error": str(exc)})
        signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, 0)
    if status != "PASS":
        raise SystemExit(1)
